Source: @miladdokhanchi

🔗 We are more connected than ever; we read the same news, live through similar crises, talk about the same topics, and sometimes share the same emotions. But do these commonalities mean "becoming us"?👥 Perhaps on the surface we are together, but can we still see each other, hear each other, and talk with one another? Does something still exist beyond scattered individualities that turns us into a "nation"?💬 In days when society faces fundamental questions about solidarity, trust, dialogue, and collective life more than ever, we want to once again put this question before ourselves: Are we becoming "us" again?🤝 At the gathering of [Jivegi] members, in addition to presenting a report on the past year and what awaits us, we will sit together to discuss the current state of Iranian society, the possibilities of being together, collective experiences, and the outlook for Iran's future.Featuring Milad Dokhanchi📅 Monday, 23 Shahrivar🕖 At 19:00📍 Pardis Mellat🎟️ Participation in this gathering is free and only includes service costs.🔗 Registration at:https://jivegi.school/products/Ahali-Jivegi2026@jivegionline

🧩 Design Thinking; From Idea to Execution
Every idea needs more than just creativity to become a successful product; you need to see the problem correctly, develop the idea, turn it into a product, and take concrete steps to execute it.
In the "Design Thinking; From Idea to Execution" workshop, you will work on real challenges and ideas using design thinking tools and techniques, and experience the journey of turning an idea into a product up close.
By the end of the workshop, you won't just be a listener; you'll leave with an Action Plan to continue your idea or project.
🔹 Taught and coached by:
Dr. Milad Khanchi
Dr. Hamed Safaeipour

Thursday, September 10 | 3 PM to 7 PM
Friday, September 11 | 9 AM to 1 PM and 2 PM to 6 PM
🔸 Duration: 12 hours
🔸 Format: In-person
🔸 Capacity: Limited
If you have an idea that has been on your mind for a long time, or a product you want to make better and more effective, this workshop can be a great starting point to turn your idea into action. 🌱
